mechanism: Rizatriptan (5-HT1B/1D agonist) combined with chlorpromazine (D2 antagonist with some serotonergic effects) increases risk of serotonin syndrome and additive CNS depression; chlorpromazine may inhibit metabolism of rizatriptan.
action: Avoid concurrent use or monitor closely for serotonin syndrome symptoms (agitation, confusion, muscle rigidity, hyperthermia); consider alternative antipsychotic with lower serotonergic activity.
